articles.title: Listen to this: Armand Hammer’s Snakes & Ladders
articles.description: I open with this caveat: I haven't had a ton of time to digest the surprise Armand Hammer record that dropped this week. Billy Woods and Elucid rarely miss, though, and my initial reaction is that Snakes & Ladders ranks among their best. articles.title: Vulcan rocket fails, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites
articles.description: United Launch Alliance (ULA) suffered what is reportedly its first mission failure in its 20-year history, failing to deliver 40 Amazon Leo satellites to orbit. Leo is Amazon's competitor to SpaceX's Starlink, but it has struggled to get off the ground so far, putting only a small portion of the necessary satellites to challenge Starlink […]
